second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (63 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side prints label 14 twice (fill q014, q014b) and 35 twice (one-mark q035, two-mark q035b); 65 questions. Answer side: fill keys 6-15 run continuously, so key 15 'recycling' answers q014b (left EMPTY with 'shifted numbering — see key 15'); the T/F keys restart at 15 and fit 15-24 by printed number; [match block]; 26-35 one-mark, then '35.' again opening the two-mark run (pairs with q035b by printed label and order), 36-62. q063 (colouring) no key. Difficulty per question: easy 32, average 6, difficult 22, untagged 5.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 46 (heading, LO) 47-51; A pdf 148 (heading, keys 1-15 + T/F) 149-150.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5 (untagged heading and stems -> 5 x 'no difficulty tag'); s2 fill q6-14b; s3 T/F q15-24; s4 '25. Match the following with correct answers (easy)' q25; s5 one mark q26-35 vsa; s6 two marks q35b-42 sa; s7 three marks q43-52 sa; s8 four marks q53-63 la.

NUMBERING (analysis: reports/class-4-evs/evs-4-11_numbering_analysis.md): q014b <- key 15 of the fill run is a one-question offset from the repeated label 14 -> default lane EMPTY + pointer (v2 §4.2). The T/F run's own '15.' restarts the numbering and every T/F key fits by number. q035b pairs with the second printed '35.' (same printed label, second occurrence, same section) — not displaced.

Key-side text-layer joins handled by hand: 'Fill in the blanks with appropriate answers 6. wet', 'State whether the following statements are true or false 15. True'. Stray characters 'Garbage Management Qa / SB' above the key's first heading (pdf 148) are not keys (residue).
Tags printed without ')' ('(Average' q48, q51, q54) and without '(' ('growth?Difficult)' q36) read as tags.
q63 dustbins figure -> stimulus crop images/evs-4-11/stimuli/ (ruling D4); no key -> 'no answer printed'. q36 prints two questions under one label (flagged).
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_11.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
